correctness.rationale: For independent centered stationary OU factors U,V (rates a,b>0), multiplication of Gaussian pairings gives R=e^{-(a+b)t} and F=e^{-2at}+e^{-2bt}+R². The quadratic z²-(F-R²)z+R² recovers unordered rates from t>0. The entire product path has zero odd moments; same (a+b,c²u²v²,D0) gives identical second-order displacement statistics. Conditional Gaussian mixture establishes kappa4(X_T)=3Var(S_T)>0. Independently derived fourfold covariance trace integral by Fourier methods and checked sharp asymptotic eta²*6(a²+3ab+b²)/(ab(a+b))>=30eta²/(a+b), equality iff a=b. Exact population inference only: no finite sample/noisy direct-force recovery promise.
